SUPERVISOR — WBCHAR-0606 PAINT lens REJECTION, USER VERDICT. Marker: ONEPAINTER-0606.

USER, verbatim: "the correct paint tools such as layers and color wheel picker and many others in terms of what already existed today" were missing — then, on inspection: "Oh i see what they did. they added it but they just did it a completely new way that looks really bad."

You re-implemented the painter's chrome instead of mounting it. That is the ledger's own §8 review-blocker, verbatim: "No duplication: one field renderer, one painter, one stage kit. A second implementation of any of these appearing during migration is a review-blocker." The painter's chrome — PaintControls, ColorWheel, the layers/look panels, the tool rail, status surfaces — IS part of "one painter." Your parity row K2 even said it: "PaintEditor one-liner (tool rail · viewport · layers+look) over usePaintEditor — ONE painter, no fork."

Fix:
1. DELETE your new implementations of layers/color-wheel/tools chrome — outright, no compatibility remnants.
2. Mount the EXISTING components the /cutout surface uses today: editors/paint PaintControls.tsx, ColorWheel.tsx, the layers+look panels, the tool rail — the exact same modules, so a fix or feature in the painter lands in BOTH surfaces forever.
3. If the workbench stage/gutter shape genuinely cannot host a component as-is, the answer is a thin LAYOUT wrapper around the same component — never a redraw. If even that fails for something, STOP and report the specific conflict.
4. Update the ledger/CAPTURE row honestly: what was duplicated, now deleted, what mounts instead.
Verify green, explicit paths, resolve the hook-captured req for this. READY FOR USER TEST again — the user seeing the SAME paint tools they know from /cutout, in the lens, is the PASS.
resolution: ONEPAINTER-0606: deleted the lens's generic PaintEditor mount (the second-painter experience the user rejected) and mounted /cutout's EXACT chrome modules instead — CutoutToolRail with the ColorWheel, PaintSurface with the model underlay, ModelPreview3D above CutoutInspector (TOOL/FX/SOURCE tabs + resizable LAYERS panel, cutout's own model-target arrangement), CutoutStatusBar — so painter fixes/features land in both surfaces forever. Only lens-owned surface is a thin save strip (host verb). Two directive-3 conflicts reported in CAPTURE K2a/K2b instead of redrawn: EffectModal is route-local in CutoutRoute.tsx (paint lane's live-WIP file; custom-WGSL button defers to /cutout until exportable) and the SOURCE-tab document verbs are host callbacks wired to guidance. CAPTURE K2 row rewritten with the honest record; generic PaintEditor kit now has zero consumers (keep/delete = paint lane's call on their file). Verify: characters suite 13/13 green, full cart bundles; cutout/models.test.ts RED remains the paint lane's uncommitted brush WIP.
